title: Mini Concrete Pump for Narrow and Confined Construction Sites
seoTitle: Mini Concrete Pump for Narrow Confined Sites | Pinjin Xingtai
description: ‘Mini concrete pump’ is a search term, not a Pinjin model name. Compare confined-site access using published size and weight: B500S-83D 280 kg, Electric 10 Series 400 kg, Electric 15 450 kg, rural diesel 800 kg.

answerBlock.what: Pinjin does not list a product named Mini. For narrow and confined sites we compare published envelopes: B500S-83D 915 × 550 × 550 mm / 280 kg / 5 m reach / 5–16 mm stone; Electric 10 Series 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm / 400 kg; Electric 15 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm / 450 kg; rural diesel 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm / 800 kg.
answerBlock.who: Buyers whose gate, stair or indoor floor cannot take a 1200–2300 kg trailer, and who can state stone size, reach and whether 380 V is available.
factors: Width and weight versus the gate — use the millimetre row, not the word mini
Reach: B500S-83D is 5 m height / 5 m horizontal, not a house pipeline pump
Aggregate: 5–16 mm on B500S versus 2 cm / 1–3 cm on the compact trailers
Power: 7.5 kW / 380 V, 15 kW electric, or 17 kW diesel if there is no grid

faqs.question: Which Pinjin model is the mini concrete pump?
faqs.answer: None. Mini is a marketplace search term. We compare B500S-83D, Electric 10 Series, Electric 15 and the rural diesel compact by size, reach and aggregate. Equating mini with any one slug would be false.

faqs.question: Is B500S-83D a trailer concrete pump?
faqs.answer: It is a compact two-stage manual/electric unit with a short boom on the machine — 5 m / 5 m, 280 kg, sand and 5–16 mm stone. It is not a truck-mounted placing boom and not Electric 15.
